subject: Follow-up: RAG eval & model recommendations
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: RAG eval & model recommendations

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sam — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps I promised: 

1) What we heard from you
- Primary goal: improve answers for product support articles and legal FAQs with high precision grounding.
- Constraints: sub-second tail latency for interactive agent UI, and strict PII handling for support transcripts.
- Volume: ~1.2M queries/mo, peak concurrent ~120 QPS.

2) Immediate recommendations (RAG + model fit)
- Retriever: hybrid semantic + lexical (dense embeddings + BM25) for recall on short KB docs. Start with semantic top_k=100 + bm25 boost for long docs.
- Reranker: a cross-encoder reranker (we recommend cross-enc-reranker-v1) to improve top-5 precision for grounding.
- Models for generation: prefer a smaller instruction-tuned model for latency-critical flows (Mistral-Instruct-7B quantized) for 95th-percentile latency, with a fallback to a higher-capacity model (Llama-2-13B-chat q4) for complex multi-step answers where quality matters.

3) Evaluation & metrics to watch
- Groundedness@1 / Groundedness@5 (percent of responses with top-1/top-5 documents cited and correct)
- Hallucination rate on a 200-case prompt set we discussed
- Latency p95 token generation for interactive flows
- Cost per 1k queries (we can simulate with your query distribution)

4) Deliverables from Redwood
- Baseline RAG eval run (semantic + bm25) with: retrieval precision/recall, reranker lift, grounding metrics, and a recommended model profile.
- Attached: prompt set (acme-prompt-sets.csv) and the evaluation plan.
- Link to shared folder with detailed results after we run the baseline.

Next steps
- We’ll run a 48–72 hour baseline eval against a 500–1k sample of your queries. Please confirm the dataset to use (support transcripts or product KB).
- Rishi will send a trial configuration and pricing for Dedicated capacity if you want longer-running tests.

Thanks — I’ll kick this off once you confirm the sample and any IP/PII redaction requirements.

Best,
Marissa

Great questions — answers below and I attached the initial eval PDF with preliminary numbers from a quick local run. Full baseline will be posted to the Drive link in ~48 hours.

1) Reranker: evaluation vs production
- Eval: we run the cross-encoder reranker offline during the eval to measure lift (precision@1/5) and compute latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Prod options: you can run the reranker at query-time (best precision) or use a two-stage approach where an inexpensive bi-encoder prunes to top-50 then the cross-encoder re-ranks top-5. That hybrid approach typically gives ~90–95% of the precision with much lower avg latency. We’ll include both simulated cost/latency numbers.

2) Grounding metrics (definitions)
- Groundedness@1 = (# responses where top-1 returned doc contains a verifiable answer according to the eval rubric) / (total eval queries)
- Groundedness@5 = same but checks if any of top-5 docs contain the verifiable answer
- Hallucination rate = (# responses where model asserts facts not present in top-5 docs) / (total eval queries)
- Reranker lift = precision@1 with reranker / precision@1 without reranker

3) Retrieval settings we recommend for baseline
- Embeddings: Redwood-emb-1024 (dense) with faiss HNSW index
- Hybrid search: semantic top_k=100 + bm25 boost (bm25 window=500 tokens)
- Candidate prune: bi-encoder to 50, cross-encoder to 5 for production simulations

4) Attachments & links
- Attached: redwood-rag-eval-results.pdf (quick run) and acme-prompt-sets.csv (the prompts you gave us)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-redwood-acme-rag-eval (full results will land here)
- HubSpot deal page: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

We’ll proceed with the 48–72 hour baseline against the anonymized support sample unless you tell us otherwise. If you want the faster latency profile, we’ll simulate the two-stage reranker approach in the report.

Thanks — will follow up when the baseline completes.

Best,
Marissa
